init_MCTS: create an MCTS agent with a search space, trainer, and tree height for neural architecture search
run_MCTS_search: run the MCTS search loop to iteratively sample and evaluate neural network architectures
select_MCTS_node: select a leaf node from the MCTS tree using UCT-based exploration with boundary constraints
backpropagate_MCTS: backpropagate accuracy results from a leaf node up through the MCTS tree to update statistics
dump_MCTS_agent: dump the MCTS agent state including samples and search counter to a pickle file
